SEO AUDIT

Northwest General Dentistry — SEO audit

Clear issues, real evidence and focused fixes.

67 sitemap URLs · 67 distinct HTML pages · read-only · October 7

Generic Product markup needs removalThe homepage background is a 42.6 MB animationA drafting instruction is publicly visibleThe thank-you page is open to search indexingUseful guides are disconnected from the siteFix order
01

Generic Product markup needs removal

37 pages repeat a generic service Product with price “$$”; Dentist schema also references a missing practice image.

  • Remove the generic Product graph, including its offers and repeated review; keep valid Dentist priceRange and business details.
  • Replace Dentist image clinic-image.jpg with a verified current practice image/logo; recheck the review snapshot before updating 306 to 343.
02

The homepage background is a 42.6 MB animation

The hero uses a 690-frame animated WebP weighing 42.6 MB, far beyond a lightweight background.

  • Use a quality-preserving static mobile poster and a smaller animation/video treatment.
  • Retest visual loading and LCP separately; the full file size is not a confirmed download or sole speed cause.
03

A drafting instruction is publicly visible

The Dental Bridges page tells readers to “incorporate the high-authority reference,” exposing an editing note in the introduction.

  • Remove that instruction from #span-18-186 while keeping the surrounding patient-facing text and useful reference link.
04

The thank-you page is open to search indexing

The submitted-form confirmation page is indexable and listed in the XML sitemap, although it is not a search landing page.

  • Set thank-you-organic to noindex and remove it from XML; keep the working page and conversion flow intact.
05

Useful guides are disconnected from the site

Twelve educational guides have no homepage link path; ten have no incoming links, and two have only article-to-article links.

  • Create an approved patient-resource hub linked under About or in the footer, then add natural links from relevant services; keep the existing useful guides.

Fix order

Clean up Product/schema and the visible drafting note, then reduce animation weight and exclude the utility page.

  • Website: remove only the mapped Product blocks, repair Dentist image, editing note and hero media.
  • SEO/content: exclude only the confirmation page from search and connect useful guides through a resource hub and relevant service links.

The animation filesize is verified but is not every visitor's measured transfer or the proven LCP cause. Valid business data and tracking remain. No live changes.
